name: target-finder
subject: addCompetitors
meaning: A viewfinder on a focusing rail: slide the sight forward to locate a rival product.
interaction: Fixed rest hit area; 700ms EASE_LIFT tween; bounded reach; linked responses delayed 40ms; loop sleeps after settlement.
reducedMotion: SSR rest geometry remains complete. Shared CustomHairlineFigure disables pointer code and asset enhancement for reduced motion.
